note: End-effector constrained parkour (effectors.py): hands on a bar or ledge, feet on a wall, placed by geometry. Never put Epic GASP data in here (README.md).
description: A spike: can constraints make Kimodo's parkour touch what the level holds?

clips.name: Parkour/Bar_Hang
clips.prompt: A person hangs from a horizontal bar above their head with both hands, arms straight, legs hanging down, swaying slightly.

clips.name: Parkour/Bar_Swing
clips.prompt: A person hanging from a horizontal bar with both hands swings their whole body forward and back like a pendulum.

clips.name: Parkour/Shimmy_Left
clips.prompt: A person hangs from a ledge by both hands with their legs hanging down and shimmies sideways to their left, moving one hand at a time.

clips.name: Parkour/Wall_Run_Right
clips.prompt: A person runs along a wall on their right side, taking several steps on the wall with their body leaning away from it, then drops back to the ground and keeps running.
